name: Carousel Maker for Divi – Image carousel & Logo Carousel
author: Fahim Reza

sections.description:
Carousel Maker for Divi Builder – The Ultimate Divi Carousel Plugin

Carousel Maker for Divi is a high-performance, fully customizable carousel plugin built specifically for the Divi Theme and Divi Builder. It allows you to create beautiful, interactive sliders using any Divi module, helping you present content in a dynamic, space-efficient format.

Whether you’re displaying client logos, images, testimonials, blog posts, team members, or WooCommerce products, Carousel Maker gives you complete creative freedom and exceptional control over your design.

Key Highlights:

✔ Use any Divi module inside a carousel layout
✔ Fully responsive, touch-friendly, and lightweight
✔ Optimized for SEO and fast page loads
✔ Drag-and-drop support with Divi Builder
✔ Works seamlessly with the Divi Theme and Divi Builder Plugin

Designed for:

✔ Creative professionals using Divi
✔ Agencies building client sites
✔ Store owners showcasing products with WooCommerce
✔ Bloggers featuring posts and testimonials
✔ Anyone who wants to enhance the user experience with carousels

Core Features

✔ Carousel Maker – Use any Divi module inside a custom carousel.
✔ Divi Image Carousel – Add images with transitions, autoplay, and navigation styles.
✔ Divi Logo Carousel – Showcase partner or sponsor logos with links and hover effects.
✔ Autoplay & Loop – Control how your slides rotate and repeat.
✔ Custom Navigation – Choose from arrows, dots, or both.
✔ Responsive Design – Optimized for mobile, tablet, and desktop.
✔ Fast & Lightweight – Built for speed, with clean and efficient code.
✔ SEO Friendly – Output is optimized for search engines and accessibility.

Coming Soon in Pro Version

We’re working on something amazing. The Pro version of Carousel Maker for Divi will unlock premium modules and advanced features to help you create stunning, professional-grade carousels in seconds.

Premium Modules:

✪ Divi Testimonial Carousel – Share reviews and feedback in an elegant slider.
✪ Team Carousel – Display your team members with style and interactivity.
✪ Divi Video Carousel – Add YouTube, Vimeo, or MP4 videos with playback options.
✪ Divi Post Carousel – Feature blog posts with featured images, titles, and metadata.
✪ WooCommerce Product Carousel – Show products with prices and CTA buttons.
✪ Lightbox Support – Enable pop-up previews for images and videos.
✪ Advanced Controls – Fine-tune autoplay, loop, slide speed, and layout options.

Perfect for growing websites and design-savvy users, the Pro version gives you all the tools to create immersive, conversion-driven carousels.

Built exclusively for Divi, optimized for performance, and packed with powerful features — Carousel Maker for Divi is the only Divi Carousel plugin you need.

📌 Note: The Divi Theme or Divi Builder Plugin is required to use this plugin.

Support

Need help? Our friendly team is ready to assist. Reach out via the support forum or our contact page for fast and helpful support.

Disclaimer

This plugin is not affiliated with or endorsed by Elegant Themes or PeeAye Creative. “Divi” is a registered trademark of Elegant Themes, Inc.
sections.installation:
Note: This plugin works with Divi. Ensure you have Divi Theme installed.

  1. Install Divi Carousel via the WordPress plugin directory or by uploading the files to your server at wp-content/plugins.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Add the carousel modules to your Divi Builder and customize them as needed.

For more information, please visit our Knowledge Base.
sections.faq:
Does Carousel Maker for Divi work with any WordPress theme?

No, Carousel Maker for Divi is built exclusively for the Divi Theme and Divi Builder by Elegant Themes. It will not function with other WordPress themes or builders.

Is Carousel Maker for Divi responsive and mobile-friendly?

Absolutely! All carousels created with Divi Carousel modules are fully responsive, touch-enabled, and optimized to look great on desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

Can I use any Divi module inside a carousel?

Yes! One of the most powerful features of Carousel Maker is the ability to use any Divi module—including custom or third-party modules—inside a carousel layout.

Is the plugin SEO-friendly?

Yes, Carousel Maker for Divi is optimized for SEO with clean code and accessible markup. It helps ensure your carousels don’t slow down your site or hurt your search rankings.

What premium features are available in Carousel Maker Pro?

The Pro version unlocks advanced modules like Testimonial Carousel, Team Carousel, Video Carousel, WooCommerce Product Slider, Blog Post Carousel, Lightbox, and more.

Where can I get support or documentation?

For help, visit our Knowledge Base or reach out via our Support Contact Form. Our team is ready to assist you with anything related to Divi Carousel Maker.

Will the plugin slow down my website?

No. Carousel Maker for Divi is built with performance in mind. It’s lightweight, modular, and avoids bloated scripts to ensure fast page loading times.
